description: This file defines the TimesheetTimeFormatAPI class, an API endpoint for retrieving the timesheet time format configuration within the OrangeHRM system. It implements a GET method to fetch the configuration, utilizing various core API traits and models, and is part of the Time plugin's API namespace.
